summary.name: venommakeup
summary.one_liner: venommakeup is an independent fan AI video tool that turns one adult face photo into a ~10 second 9:16 Halloween half-face glossy black goo (Symbiote/Venom-style) makeup clip.
use_cases: vertical short-form video from a single portrait
summary.what_it_does: Users upload one clear adult face photo (no prompt needed) and the tool generates a ~10 second 9:16 vertical clip in which half the face is covered in glossy black goo with a jagged white eye and fang glint, while the clean half stays recognizable. The page says it uses Seedance for generation and outputs a 720p render. Pricing is pay-per-video via credit packs (single $8.88 for 500 credits, one 720p render; 480p uses 375 credits), with failed renders refunded as credits. Photos are said to stay local for preview and be used via a short-lived private link for rendering, with source photos not kept as a long-term gallery.
notable: One photo, no prompt: upload a face and tap Create to get a locked half-face goo look
Pay once credit packs with no subscription; failed renders restore credits
Explicitly an independent fan tool, not affiliated with Marvel, Sony, or official Venom
caveats: Adults who agreed only (18+); not for children, celebrities, or strangers
Render links expire, so MP4s must be downloaded promptly
Output is 720p for the base price; the page says AI-generated content should be labeled when posted
